(5) The man holds the finished titanium plate upright in front of him, displaying the results of his work. His hands are positioned at the bottom corners of the plate. He looks directly at the camera with a satisfied expression. The wooden mallet lies on the table next to the wooden block. The lighting remains bright and consistent throughout.
